_comment: Generated by `make docs-shots` (e2e/tests-docs/write-manifest.js); checked by scripts/ci/guard-docs-shots.sh. Do not edit by hand.
algorithm: sha256; surface_files = per file of the sorted fileset (web/ui/** + web/public/** + non-test internal/pages/**.go, excluding a file whose only registered routes are all unscreenshotted, ut-docs#620, testdata/ fixtures, ut-docs#1351, and dotfiles, ut-docs#659), {relpath: {sha256: sha256(file)}}, one entry per file so concurrent UI PRs merge clean, ut-docs#6654; topic hashes = sha256 of the topic markdown (en fallback); shots = per topic, the extra screenshots its English markdown references (img/<id>-<part>.png, ut-docs#2615), each also captured per locale. Full spec in e2e/tests-docs/lib.js.
